feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 September 2026 10:09pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 08 September 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the North Sea gradually filling as an area of high pressure to the west of Ireland gradually approaches the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the north and east of the area at first, decreasing 4 or 5 tomorrow morning, backing west or northwest 2 to 4 tomorrow afternoon, settling south or southwest 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the north and east at first, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow morning, then slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 to 5, increasing 6 in the west of the area overnight into Thursday, settling southerly 5 to 7 in all waters later on Thursday morning, veering southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building mainly moderate overnight and occasionally rough in the west. Becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional rain or drizzle approaching from the west on Thursday morning, this tending to clear later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
